title: A Dose-Finding Study in Japanese Patients to Evaluate the Effect of Obicetrapib as an Adjunct to Stable Statin Therapy.

sections.abstract:
This study will be a placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomized, phase 2 dose-finding study in Japanese patients to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of obicetrapib as an adjunct to stable statin therapy.

Posted outcomes: Mean Percent Change in Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) [Friedewald]. timeframe=8 Weeks. Placebo=-0.78 (±14.581); 2.5 mg Obicetrapib=-25.90 (±21.259); 5 mg Obicetrapib=-33.78 (±13.247). p=<.0001
